title: Canonical scalar-counit equation for one affine coordinate
statement: For the standing positive-characteristic field, distinct prime ell, finite coefficient rings A and B killed by N=ell^n and a ring map phi, let T be separated finite type over k. Use the actual standard open/projective affine-line adjunction, the root-normalized reductionEtaleLineScalarIso, and the specified standard compactification coefficient map. On every ctf input K their composite with the B counit equals scalar extension of the A counit. This is the single-coordinate constituent of [lem-sp-affine-counit-scalar], with the canonical roots fixed as in [def-sp-affine-counit-comparison-objects].

proof.text: Cancel the root kernel inclusion in the same-annihilator roots_power equation, using N/N=1. The generators and uniqueness of reductionEtaleTateMap identify the sheaf adjunct. On the flat Tate line the scalar/single-complex adjunction computation identifies the derived comparison with reductionEtaleTateIso.
The open coefficient inverse is the open mate of the inverse scalar/pullback comparison. Apply the mate counit identity and cancel its isomorphism to obtain the open scalar-counit square.

Apply the P1 scalar counit identity with its normalized data. Expand the affine composite counit. Open counit naturality moves the P1 right comparison past it; apply the preceding open square, proper coefficient naturality, then the P1 scalar square. Functoriality gives the displayed equality.

theorem affineLineCanonicalScalarCounit
    (ell p n : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (hp : 0 < p) (hEll : p ≠ ell)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hA : ((ell ^ n : ℕ) : A) = 0) (hB : ((ell ^ n : ℕ) : B) = 0)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (T ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (T ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hT : IsUnit ((ell ^ n : ℕ) : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (tA : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A (ell ^ n) hA)
    (tB : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport B (ell ^ n) hB)
    (dA : OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A (ell ^ n) hA tA T hT)
    (dB : OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum B (ell ^ n) hB tB T hT)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A T)
    (hK : ProEtale.AdjunctionTransfer.etaleProperty A T K) :
    ProEtale.CoefficientCompatibility.etaleCoefficientMap φ
        (affineTraceLineCompactification T) ((affineTraceLineRight A (ell ^ n) hA T).obj K) ≫
      (affineTraceLineLeft B T).map
        (ProEtale.reductionEtaleLineScalarIso φ T (ell ^ n) hA hB hT K).hom ≫
      (affineTraceLineAdjunction B (ell ^ n) hB tB T hT dB).counit.app
        ((scalarExtension φ T).obj K) =
    (scalarExtension φ T).map
      ((affineTraceLineAdjunction A (ell ^ n) hA tA T hT dA).counit.app K)
